feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 August 2026 11:37am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 16 August 2026 at 11:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A declining ridge from the Azores High to the North Sea.


##Wind##

Southwest imminently backing south-southwest or southerly, 3 or 4. Veering west or northwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Scattered outbreaks of rain towards the English and Welsh coasts at first, otherwise mainly fair, then outbreaks of light rain spreading from the west this evening, becoming mostly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps occasionally moderate in places.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4, soon backing southwest, then increasing south or southwest 4 or 5 later on Monday evening, veering west overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional patchy light rain, becoming more widespread & persistent Monday evening. Becoming mainly fair overnight into Tuesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
